vsm2.20:18.1: So tasseva pañcasu khandhesu aniccadukkhānattasammasanassa thirabhāvatthāya, yaṃ taṃ bhagavatā ‘‘katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi anulomikaṃ khantiṃ paṭilabhati,
vsm2.20:18.2: katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamatī’’ti etassa vibhaṅge –
vsm2.20:18.3: ‘‘Pañcakkhandhe aniccato, dukkhato, rogato, gaṇḍato, sallato, aghato, ābādhato, parato, palokato, ītito, upaddavato, bhayato, upasaggato, calato, pabhaṅguto, addhuvato,
vsm2.20:18.4: atāṇato, aleṇato, asaraṇato, rittato, tucchato, suññato, anattato, ādīnavato, vipariṇāmadhammato, asārakato, aghamūlato, vadhakato, vibhavato, sāsavato, saṅkhatato, mārāmisato,
vsm2.20:18.5: jātidhammato, jarādhammato, byādhidhammato, maraṇadhammato, sokadhammato, paridevadhammato, upāyāsadhammato, saṃkilesikadhammato’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.37) –
vsm2.20:18.6: Cattārīsāya ākārehi, ‘‘Pañcakkhandhe aniccato passanto anulomikaṃ khantiṃ paṭilabhati.
vsm2.20:18.7: Pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ nirodho niccaṃ nibbānanti passanto sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamatī’’tiādinā (paṭi. ma. 3.38) nayena,
vsm2.20:19.1: Kathaṃ? So hi ekekaṃ khandhaṃ anaccantikatāya, ādiantavantatāya ca aniccato.
vsm2.20:19.2: Uppādavayapaṭipīḷanatāya, dukkhavatthutāya ca dukkhato. Paccayayāpanīyatāya, rogamūlatāya ca rogato.
vsm2.20:19.3: Dukkhatāsūlayogitāya, kilesāsucipaggharaṇatāya, uppādajarābhaṅgehi uddhumātaparipakkapabhinnatāya ca gaṇḍato. Pīḷājanakatāya, antotudanatāya, dunnīharaṇīyatāya ca sallato.
vsm2.20:19.4: Vigarahaṇīyatāya, avaḍḍhiāvahanatāya, aghavatthutāya ca aghato. Aseribhāvajanakatāya, ābādhapadaṭṭhānatāya ca ābādhato. Avasatāya, avidheyyatāya ca parato.
vsm2.20:19.6: Aviditānaṃyeva vipulānaṃ anatthānaṃ āvahanato, sabbupaddavavatthutāya ca upaddavato. Sabbabhayānaṃ ākaratāya, dukkhavūpasamasaṅkhātassa paramassāsassa paṭipakkhabhūtatāya ca bhayato.
vsm2.20:19.7: Anekehi anatthehi anubaddhatāya, dosūpasaṭṭhatāya, upasaggo viya anadhivāsanārahatāya ca upasaggato. Byādhijarāmaraṇehi ceva lābhālābhādīhi ca lokadhammehi pacalitatāya calato.
vsm2.20:19.8: Upakkamena ceva sarasena ca pabhaṅgupagamanasīlatāya pabhaṅguto. Sabbāvatthanipātitāya, thirabhāvassa ca abhāvatāya addhuvato.
vsm2.20:19.9: Atāyanatāya ceva, alabbhaneyyakhematāya ca atāṇato. Allīyituṃ anarahatāya, allīnānampi ca leṇakiccākāritāya aleṇato. Nissitānaṃ bhayasārakattābhāvena asaraṇato.
vsm2.20:19.10: Yathāparikappitehi dhuvasubhasukhattabhāvehi rittatāya rittato. Rittatāyeva tucchato appakattā vā, appakampi hi loke tucchanti vuccati. Sāmi-nivāsi-kāraka-vedakādhiṭṭhāyakavirahitatāya suññato.
vsm2.20:19.12: Pavattidukkhatāya, dukkhassa ca ādīnavatāya ādīnavato, atha vā ādīnaṃ vāti gacchati pavattatīti ādīnavo, kapaṇamanussassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ, khandhāpi ca kapaṇāyevāti ādīnavasadisatāya ādīnavato.
vsm2.20:19.13: Jarāya ceva maraṇena cāti dvedhā pariṇāmapakatitāya vipariṇāmadhammato. Dubbalatāya, pheggu viya sukhabhañjanīyatāya ca asārakato.
vsm2.20:19.14: Aghahetutāya aghamūlato. Mittamukhasapatto viya vissāsaghātitāya vadhakato. Vigatabhavatāya, vibhavasambhūtatāya ca vibhavato.
vsm2.20:19.15: Āsavapadaṭṭhānatāya sāsavato. Hetupaccayehi abhisaṅkhatatāya saṅkhatato. Maccumārakilesamārānaṃ āmisabhūtatāya mārāmisato.
vsm2.20:19.17: Taṇhādiṭṭhiduccaritasaṃkilesānaṃ visayadhammatāya saṃkilesikadhammatoti evaṃ pabhedato vuttassa aniccādisammasanassa vasena sammasati.
vsm2.20:20.1: Ettha hi aniccato, palokato, calato, pabhaṅguto, addhuvato, vipariṇāmadhammato, asārakato, vibhavato, saṅkhatato, maraṇadhammatoti ekekasmiṃ khandhe dasa dasa katvā paññāsa aniccānupassanāni.
vsm2.20:20.2: Parato, rittato, tucchato, suññato, anattatoti ekekasmiṃ khandhe pañca pañca katvā pañcavīsati anattānupassanāni.
vsm2.20:20.3: Sesāni dukkhato, rogatotiādīni ekekasmiṃ khandhe pañcavīsati pañcavīsati katvā pañcavīsatisataṃ dukkhānupassanānīti.
vsm2.20:20.4: Iccassa iminā dvisatabhedena aniccādisammasanena pañcakkhandhe sammasato taṃ nayavipassanāsaṅkhātaṃ aniccadukkhānattasammasanaṃ thiraṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:21.1: Yassa pana evaṃ nayavipassanāya yogaṃ karotopi nayavipassanā na sampajjati, tena ‘‘navahākārehi indriyāni tikkhāni bhavanti – uppannuppannānaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ khayameva passati,
vsm2.20:21.2: tattha ca sakkaccakiriyāya sampādeti, sātaccakiriyāya sampādeti, sappāyakiriyāya sampādeti, samādhissa ca nimittaggāhena, bojjhaṅgānañca anupavattanatāya,
vsm2.20:21.3: kāye ca jīvite ca anapekkhataṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, tattha ca abhibhuyya nekkhammena, antarā ca abyosānenā’’ti evaṃ vuttānaṃ navannaṃ ākārānaṃ vasena indriyāni tikkhāni katvā
vsm2.20:21.4: pathavīkasiṇaniddese vuttanayena satta asappāyāni vajjetvā satta sappāyāni sevamānena kālena rūpaṃ sammasitabbaṃ, kālena arūpaṃ.
vsm2.20:23.4: yaṃ evaṃ lahuparivattaṃ yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, citta’’nti (a. ni. 1.48).
vsm2.20:24.1: Rūpe dharanteyeva hi soḷasavāre bhavaṅgacittaṃ uppajjitvā nirujjhati.
vsm2.20:24.3: Rūpassa pana uppādabhaṅgakkhaṇāyeva lahukā, tehi sadisā.
vsm2.20:24.4: Ṭhitikkhaṇo pana mahā, yāva soḷasa cittāni uppajjitvā nirujjhanti, tāva vattati.
vsm2.20:25.1: Paṭisandhicittassa uppādakkhaṇe uppannaṃ ṭhānappattaṃ purejātaṃ vatthuṃ nissāya
vsm2.20:25.3: Tena saddhiṃ uppannaṃ ṭhānappattaṃ purejātaṃ vatthuṃ nissāya
vsm2.20:25.6: Āsannamaraṇassa pana ekameva ṭhānappattaṃ purejātaṃ vatthuṃ nissāya
vsm2.20:26.2: paṭisandhicittato uddhaṃ soḷasamena cittena saddhiṃ nirujjhati.
vsm2.20:26.3: Ṭhānakkhaṇe uppannaṃ sattarasamassa uppādakkhaṇena saddhiṃ nirujjhati.
vsm2.20:26.4: Bhaṅgakkhaṇe uppannaṃ sattarasamassa ṭhānakkhaṇaṃ patvā nirujjhati.
vsm2.20:26.5: Yāva pavatti nāma atthi, evameva pavattati.
vsm2.20:28.2: Kammasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma vipākakkhandhā ca, cakkhudasakādi samasattatirūpañca.
vsm2.20:29.3: kammasamuṭṭhānarūpesu ṭhānappattā ojā aññaṃ ojaṭṭhamakaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti,
vsm2.20:29.5: evaṃ catasso vā pañca vā pavattiyo ghaṭeti.
vsm2.20:29.8: tatrāpi utu aññanti evaṃ catasso vā pañca vā pavattiyo ghaṭeti.
vsm2.20:31.2:
Tesu dvattiṃsa cittāni, chabbīsekūnavīsati;
Soḷasa rūpiriyāpathaviññattijanakā matā.
vsm2.20:31.4: manodhātuvajjā dasa kiriyā, kusalakiriyato dve abhiññācittānīti dvattiṃsa cittāni
vsm2.20:31.7: aṭṭha lokuttaracittānīti chabbīsati cittāni rūpaṃ, iriyāpathañca janayanti, na viññattiṃ.
vsm2.20:31.8: Kāmāvacare dasa bhavaṅgacittāni, rūpāvacare pañca, tisso manodhātuyo,
vsm2.20:31.9: ekā vipākāhetukamanoviññāṇadhātusomanassasahagatāti ekūnavīsati cittāni rūpameva janayanti, na iriyāpathaṃ, na viññattiṃ.
vsm2.20:31.11: cattāri āruppavipākānīti soḷasa cittāni neva rūpaṃ janayanti, na iriyāpathaṃ, na viññattiṃ.
vsm2.20:31.12: Yāni cettha rūpaṃ janenti, tāni na ṭhitikkhaṇe, bhaṅgakkhaṇe vā, tadā hi cittaṃ dubbalaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:31.13: Uppādakkhaṇe pana balavaṃ, tasmā taṃ tadā purejātaṃ vatthuṃ nissāya rūpaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti.
vsm2.20:32.1: Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma tayo arūpino khandhā, ‘‘saddanavakaṃ, kāyaviññatti, vacīviññatti, ākāsadhātu, lahutā, mudutā, kammaññatā, upacayo, santatī’’ti sattarasavidhaṃ rūpañca.
vsm2.20:32.2: Cittapaccayaṃ nāma ‘‘pacchājātā cittacetasikā dhammā purejātassa imassa kāyassā’’ti (paṭṭhā. 1.1.11) evaṃ vuttaṃ catusamuṭṭhānarūpaṃ.
vsm2.20:33.1: Cittapaccayaāhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma cittasamuṭṭhānarūpesu ṭhānappattā ojā aññaṃ
vsm2.20:33.2: ojaṭṭhamakaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti, evaṃ dve tisso pavattiyo ghaṭeti.
vsm2.20:34.1: Cittapaccayautusamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma cittasamuṭṭhāno utu ṭhānappatto aññaṃ ojaṭṭhamakaṃ
vsm2.20:34.2: samuṭṭhāpeti, evaṃ dve tisso pavattiyo ghaṭeti.
vsm2.20:36.2: Āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma upādiṇṇaṃ kammajarūpaṃ paccayaṃ labhitvā tattha patiṭṭhāya
vsm2.20:36.3: ṭhānappattāya ojāya samuṭṭhāpitaṃ ojaṭṭhamakaṃ, ākāsadhātu, lahutā, mudutā, kammaññatā, upacayo, santatīti cuddasavidhaṃ rūpaṃ.
vsm2.20:36.4: Āhārapaccayaṃ nāma ‘‘kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo’’ti (paṭṭhā. 1.1.15) evaṃ vuttaṃ catusamuṭṭhānarūpaṃ.
vsm2.20:37.1: Āhārapaccayaāhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma āhārasamuṭṭhānesu rūpesu ṭhānappattā ojā aññaṃ
vsm2.20:37.2: ojaṭṭhamakaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti, tatrāpi ojā aññanti evaṃ dasadvādasavāre pavattiṃ ghaṭeti.
vsm2.20:37.4: Dibbā pana ojā ekamāsaṃ dvemāsampi upatthambheti.
vsm2.20:37.5: Mātarā paribhuttāhāropi dārakassa sarīraṃ pharitvā rūpaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti.
vsm2.20:37.8: Sopi ṭhānappatto rūpaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti, tatrāpi ojā aññaṃ samuṭṭhāpetīti evaṃ catasso vā pañca vā pavattiyo ghaṭeti.
vsm2.20:38.1: Āhārapaccayautusamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma āhārasamuṭṭhānā tejodhātu ṭhānappattā utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ojaṭṭhamakaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti.
vsm2.20:38.2: Tatrāyaṃ āhāro āhārasamuṭṭhānānaṃ janako hutvā paccayo hoti,
vsm2.20:38.3: sesānaṃ nissayaāhāraatthiavigatavasenāti evaṃ āhārajarūpassa nibbatti passitabbā.
vsm2.20:40.1: Tattha utu nāma catusamuṭṭhānā tejodhātu, uṇhautu sītautūti evaṃ panesa duvidho hoti.
vsm2.20:40.2: Utusamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma catusamuṭṭhāno utu upādiṇṇakaṃ paccayaṃ labhitvā ṭhānappatto sarīre rūpaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti.
vsm2.20:40.3: Taṃ saddanavakaṃ, ākāsadhātu, lahutā, mudutā, kammaññatā, upacayo, santatīti pannarasavidhaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:40.4: Utupaccayaṃ nāma utu catusamuṭṭhānikarūpānaṃ pavattiyā ca vināsassa ca paccayo hoti.
vsm2.20:41.1: Utupaccayautusamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma utusamuṭṭhānā tejodhātu ṭhānappattā aññaṃ ojaṭṭhamakaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti, tatrāpi utu aññanti
vsm2.20:41.2: evaṃ dīghampi addhānaṃ anupādiṇṇapakkhe ṭhatvāpi utusamuṭṭhānaṃ pavattatiyeva.
vsm2.20:42.1: Utupaccayaāhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma utusamuṭṭhānā ṭhānappattā ojā aññaṃ ojaṭṭhamakaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti,
vsm2.20:42.2: tatrāpi ojā aññanti evaṃ dasadvādasavāre pavattiṃ ghaṭeti.
vsm2.20:42.3: Tatrāyaṃ utu utusamuṭṭhānānaṃ janako hutvā paccayo hoti,
vsm2.20:42.4: sesānaṃ nissayaatthiavigatavasenāti evaṃ utujarūpassa nibbatti passitabbā.
vsm2.20:42.5: Evañhi rūpassa nibbattiṃ passanto kālena rūpaṃ sammasati nāma.
